Virus Family
HMPV belongs to the Paramyxoviridae family, which also includes viruses like Measles and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). https://t.co/gDqj52KUi6

nodes.author: HistoryNomad24
nodes.text:
Transmission
Spreads through coughing, sneezing, and direct contact with infected individuals or contaminated surfaces.
Highly contagious, especially in crowded places.
Symptoms -
Similar to the common cold or flu Fever 
Cough Nasal congestion Shortness of breath 
#HMPV https://t.co/9P9kjBBVmr
